nodes.text: Does this buyer unit work with tissue?
nodes.lookFor: Look for: FFPE, fresh frozen / OCT, TMAs, biopsies, resections, in vivo models. Profile each department separately.

nodes.text: No spatial fit — log it and move on
nodes.lookFor: Cells, blood or suspensions only.

nodes.text: Does this unit already own a spatial platform?
nodes.lookFor: Check publications' methods, posters, job posts, vendor customer stories. Used only to find the RNA ↔ protein gap.

nodes.text: Which kind do they own?
nodes.lookFor: GeoMx counts as Both (RNA + protein, regional). CosMx counts as Spatial RNA, CellScape as Spatial protein. Competitor platforms — RNA: Xenium and Visium / Visium HD (10x Genomics), MERSCOPE (Vizgen), Stereo-seq (STOmics). Protein: PhenoCycler / CODEX (Akoya), COMET (Lunaphore), Orion (RareCyte), MACSima (Miltenyi), MIBI (Ionpath), Hyperion / Imaging Mass Cytometry (Standard BioTools).

nodes.text: Protein gap: CellScape (single-cell) or GeoMx protein (regional)
nodes.lookFor: e.g. CosMx, Xenium, Visium, MERSCOPE.

nodes.text: RNA gap: CosMx (single-cell) or GeoMx (regional)
nodes.lookFor: e.g. CellScape, PhenoCycler, COMET, Orion.

nodes.text: What do they measure: RNA, protein, or both?
nodes.lookFor: Never assume it. Protein: antibody drugs, mIF/IHC, in-house antibodies, flow, proteomics. RNA: scRNA-seq, RNA-seq, ISH/RNAscope, NGS, barcoding, RNA therapeutics.

nodes.text: Single-cell phenotyping or regional pathway activity?
nodes.lookFor: Forgivable assumption: pick the likelier one and phrase it so they can correct you.

nodes.text: CellScape
nodes.lookFor: Own antibodies, any species, open software all strengthen this.

nodes.text: Single-cell or regional?
CosMx
GeoMx
nodes.lookFor: GeoMx NGS readout fits sequencing shops.

nodes.text: Is the company clinical stage with biomarker cohorts?
nodes.lookFor: Tiebreaker. Clinical stage tends to make GeoMx the destination even when another instrument opens the door.

nodes.text: What Area of research do they focus on?
nodes.lookFor: Cancer, Neuroscience, Drug Discovery, Infectious Disease, Diabetes, Gastro, Aging, Cardiac, Kidney, Immunology / autoimmune, Fibrosis / liver, Lung, Ophthalmology, Dermatology, Rare disease, Musculoskeletal. Mainly for personalizing outreach.

nodes.text: Are they a CRO, Academic Core, or service provider?
nodes.lookFor: Business model, not research area. Service providers judge an instrument on revenue it can generate. For academic cores, NIH S10 shared-instrument grant cycles are a strong timing signal.

nodes.text: Do they generate RNA data (RNA-seq, scRNA-seq, ISH, spatial transcriptomics)?
nodes.lookFor: Mentioning a gene or target is not enough — nearly every company does. Look for methods that produce RNA data.

nodes.text: Does their Publications or News show any IHC, IF, or Tissue Imaging?
Which technologies/services do they offer?
CellScape or GeoMx — ask: single-cell or regional?
Which Bruker Technology do they own?
nodes.lookFor: Bruker spatial platforms this unit already owns. Offer what fills the gap: CosMx owners lack protein; CellScape owners lack RNA; GeoMx owners lack single-cell.

nodes.text: Discovery call: ask RNA or protein, single-cell or regional
nodes.lookFor: The dossier is too thin to pick. Lead with these questions instead of a guess.

nodes.text: CosMx or GeoMx — ask: single-cell or regional?
nodes.lookFor: RNA work is clear; resolution is a forgivable assumption to confirm on the call.

nodes.text: Are both technologies from competitors?
nodes.lookFor: Competitor platforms — RNA: Xenium and Visium / Visium HD (10x Genomics), MERSCOPE (Vizgen), Stereo-seq (STOmics). Protein: PhenoCycler / CODEX (Akoya), COMET (Lunaphore), Orion (RareCyte), MACSima (Miltenyi), MIBI (Ionpath), Hyperion / Imaging Mass Cytometry (Standard BioTools).

answers.label: No — at least one is Bruker

nodes.text: Offer CosMx or CellScape
Is this unit a service provider (CRO, academic core)?
nodes.lookFor: Owning competitor RNA and protein platforms means a research lab is covered. Service providers still buy to add capacity or new services.

nodes.text: Deprioritize — already has competitor RNA and protein platforms
nodes.lookFor: Revisit when their instruments age or a service contract comes up for renewal.

nodes.text: Offer CellScape (GeoMx protein as second option)
nodes.lookFor: Protein gap. Calico: the CosMx group stopped using GeoMx; the imaging group wanted CellScape.

nodes.text: Offer CosMx or GeoMx (RNA gap)
nodes.lookFor: CellScape is protein only.

nodes.text: Covered by two Bruker platforms — consumables / expansion
nodes.lookFor: Not a new-instrument target.
